question.hu: Hány egyedi vásárló él Curitiba városában?
question.en: How many unique customers live in the city of Curitiba?

sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS customers FROM customers WHERE customer_city = 'curitiba';

question.hu: Hány vásárló vásárolt egynél több eladótól?
question.en: How many customers bought from more than one seller?

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM (SELECT c.customer_unique_id FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT oi.seller_id) > 1) AS t;

question.hu: Rio de Janeiro (RJ) államban melyik városban van a legtöbb egyedi vásárló?
question.en: Which city in the state of Rio de Janeiro (RJ) has the most unique customers?

sql: SELECT customer_city, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS customers FROM customers WHERE customer_state = 'RJ' GROUP BY customer_city ORDER BY customers DESC LIMIT 1;

question.hu: Mennyi a Minas Gerais (MG) államba szállított tételek teljes szállítási díja?
question.en: What is the total freight value of the items shipped to customers in Minas Gerais (MG)?

sql: SELECT SUM(oi.freight_value) AS freight FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.customer_state = 'MG';

question.hu: Melyik eladónál a legmagasabb az átlagos tételár, a legalább 50 tételt eladók közül?
question.en: Which seller has the highest average item price, among sellers with at least 50 items sold?

sql: SELECT seller_id, AVG(price) AS avg_price, COUNT(*) AS items FROM order_items GROUP BY seller_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50 ORDER BY avg_price DESC LIMIT 1;

question.hu: Hány termék tartozik a health_beauty kategóriába?
question.en: How many products belong to the health_beauty category?

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS products FROM products p JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name WHERE t.product_category_name_english = 'health_beauty';

question.hu: Mennyi szállítási díjat fizettek összesen a furniture_decor kategóriájú tételekért?
question.en: What is the total freight value paid for items in the furniture_decor category?

sql: SELECT SUM(oi.freight_value) AS freight FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name WHERE t.product_category_name_english = 'furniture_decor';

question.hu: Mely termékkategóriáknak nincs angol fordítása?
question.en: Which product categories have no English translation?

sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.product_category_name FROM products p LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name WHERE t.product_category_name IS NULL AND p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL;

question.hu: Hány toys kategóriájú tételt adtak el 2017-ben?
question.en: How many items from the toys category were sold in 2017?

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS items FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name WHERE t.product_category_name_english = 'toys' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017;

question.hu: Mennyi az átlagos értékelési pontszám a késve kiszállított rendeléseknél?
question.en: What is the average review score of orders that were delivered late?

sql: SELECT AVG(r.review_score) AS avg_score FROM order_reviews r JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date;

question.hu: Hány 5 pontos értékelés született 2018-ban?
question.en: How many 5-star reviews were written in 2018?

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS reviews FROM order_reviews WHERE review_score = 5 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM review_creation_date) = 2018;

question.hu: Mely eladók kapták a legalacsonyabb átlagos értékelést, a legalább 30 értékelt rendeléssel rendelkezők közül?
question.en: Which sellers received the lowest average review score, among sellers with at least 30 reviewed orders?

sql: SELECT oi.seller_id, AVG(r.review_score) AS avg_score, COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id) AS orders FROM order_items oi JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY oi.seller_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id) >= 30 ORDER BY avg_score LIMIT 5;

question.hu: Átlagosan hány nap telt el a futárnak átadás és a vásárlóhoz kiszállítás között, államonként?
question.en: On average, how many days passed between the handover to the carrier and the delivery to the customer, by customer state?

sql: SELECT c.customer_state, AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (o.order_delivered_customer_date - o.order_delivered_carrier_date)) / 86400) AS avg_days FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND o.order_delivered_carrier_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY avg_days DESC;

question.hu: A nap melyik órájában adják le a legtöbb rendelést?
question.en: In which hour of the day are the most orders placed?

sql: SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) AS hour, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders GROUP BY hour ORDER BY orders DESC LIMIT 1;

question.hu: Hány rendelést adtak le 2017 egyes negyedéveiben?
question.en: How many orders were placed in each quarter of 2017?

sql: SELECT EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM order_purchase_timestamp) AS quarter, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017 GROUP BY quarter ORDER BY quarter;

question.hu: Hány rendelést fizettek ki tíznél több részletben?
question.en: How many orders were paid in more than ten installments?

sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders FROM order_payments WHERE payment_installments > 10;

question.hu: Mekkora volt a legnagyobb egyedi befizetés, és milyen fizetési móddal történt?
question.en: What was the largest single payment, and with which payment type was it made?

sql: SELECT order_id, payment_type, payment_value FROM order_payments ORDER BY payment_value DESC LIMIT 1;

question.hu: Mennyi volt az utalványos (voucher) fizetések összege a 2018-as rendeléseknél?
question.en: What was the total voucher payment value for orders placed in 2018?

sql: SELECT SUM(op.payment_value) AS total FROM order_payments op JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = op.order_id WHERE op.payment_type = 'voucher' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2018;

question.hu: Melyik öt városban van a legtöbb eladó?
question.en: Which five cities have the most sellers?

sql: SELECT seller_city, COUNT(*) AS sellers FROM sellers GROUP BY seller_city ORDER BY sellers DESC LIMIT 5;

question.hu: Hány eladó adott el más államban élő vásárlónak, mint ahol ő maga van?
question.en: How many sellers sold to customers in a different state than their own?

sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.seller_id) AS sellers FROM order_items oi JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE s.seller_state <> c.customer_state;

question.hu: Mennyi a sports_leisure kategóriájú termékek átlagos tömege grammban?
question.en: What is the average weight in grams of the products in the sports_leisure category?

sql: SELECT AVG(p.product_weight_g) AS avg_weight_g FROM products p JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name WHERE t.product_category_name_english = 'sports_leisure';

question.hu: Mely rendelésekben van ötnél több tétel?
question.en: Which orders contain more than five items?

sql: SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS items FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY items DESC;

question.hu: A rendelések hány százalékát törölték?
question.en: What percentage of the orders were canceled?

sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_status = 'canceled') / COUNT(*) AS canceled_percent FROM orders;

question.hu: Hány egyedi vásárló rendelt 2017-ben és 2018-ban is?
question.en: How many unique customers placed orders in both 2017 and 2018?

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM (SELECT c.customer_unique_id FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017 INTERSECT SELECT c.customer_unique_id FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2018) AS t;

question.hu: Hány termékhez nem tartozik egyetlen fénykép sem?
question.en: How many products have no photos?

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS products FROM products WHERE product_photos_qty = 0 OR product_photos_qty IS NULL;

question.hu: Mennyi az eladók államonkénti teljes bevétele a tételárak alapján?
question.en: What is the total revenue from item prices for each seller state?

sql: SELECT s.seller_state, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id GROUP BY s.seller_state ORDER BY revenue DESC;

question.hu: Mely vásárlók adtak kettőnél több 1 pontos értékelést?
question.en: Which customers gave more than two 1-star reviews?

sql: SELECT c.customer_unique_id, COUNT(*) AS one_star_reviews FROM order_reviews r JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE r.review_score = 1 GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 2 ORDER BY one_star_reviews DESC;
